score.note: Indicative only; not a guarantee of security.

checks.title: SSH password authentication disabled
checks.remediation: Use SSH keys only: set PasswordAuthentication no AFTER verifying key-based login works.

checks.title: A host firewall is active
checks.evidence: no active packet filter detected (ufw inactive, no nft/iptables input rules) - cloud security groups may exist (cloud-init) but host firewall is still recommended
checks.remediation: Enable ufw with default deny incoming after allowing SSH (offered below with lockout protection).

checks.title: No risky services exposed to the network
checks.evidence: services listening on ALL interfaces: redis-server(tcp/6379)
checks.remediation: Bind databases/caches to localhost, remove legacy daemons (telnet/ftp/r*), or restrict with firewall rules.

checks.title: No passwordless full-sudo rules
checks.evidence: deploy ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL (common on cloud images - review whether still needed)
checks.remediation: Edit with 'visudo -f <file>' and require a password, or scope NOPASSWD to specific commands. Not automated: breaking sudo can lock you out of admin rights.

checks.title: SYN-flood cookies
checks.remediation: Set net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies=1 in /etc/sysctl.d/99-ubuntu-hardener.conf and apply with 'sysctl --system'.

checks.title: Automatic security updates
checks.remediation: Install unattended-upgrades and enable it via /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades.

checks.title: Persistent systemd journal
checks.evidence: journald storage: auto(default); /var/log/journal missing - logs are lost at reboot
checks.remediation: Create /var/log/journal and set Storage=persistent via a journald drop-in.
